subject: financial_literacy
concept: Recognizing coins and bills and understanding that money is used to get things we need or want
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts real or play coins and bills by type and states their names
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a coin/bill to its correct name and value
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, what money is used for

misconception_flags: confuses coin values based on size rather than actual denomination

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
